steps.name: skin applied, cross-origin isolated
title and brand say NoDAW Studio PRO
NoDAW button opens the v2 teaser panel
Easy generate (genre synth)
Advanced mode: audible with a real tap (RMS > 0.002)
no horizontal overflow (Advanced)
Live FX: scenes, limiter, bypass, undo/redo change the sound
Live FX: export of the mix is non-silent WAV
Sampler: region, crop, undo, BPM detect, chop to pads
Pads play from the Sampler tab (pad 1 audition)
Split in browser (mini) on split_clip.wav: stems non-silent, sum ~ mix
steps.note: mini: 4 stems 20s 1.43x of clip length WASM multi Light preview (Mini-RoFormer) model | stems 4 SNR 27.0 dB

steps.name: split stems play audibly in the mixer
no horizontal overflow (after all tabs)
no console errors
autoplay blocked: gate banner appears, then a real tap is audible
